scenes.sub: Impermanent loss (IL) is how much the LP position lags simply holding the same starting tokens when their relative price changes: IL = 2√r ÷ (1 + r) − 1 (r = new price ÷ entry price). It's "impermanent" only if price returns. Withdraw after the move and it's p
scenes.vo: Impermanent loss (impermanent loss) is how much the L.P. position lags simply holding the same starting tokens when their relative price changes: impermanent loss = 2the square root of r divided by (1 + r) minus 1 (r = new price divided by entry price). It's "impermanent" only if price returns. Withdraw after the move and it's permanent. Full L.P. P and L = L.P. value + fees + incentives minus gas, compared to hold value.
scenes.cap: Impermanent loss (IL) is how much the LP position lags simply holding the same starting tokens when their relative price changes: IL = 2√r ÷ (1 + r) − 1 (r = new price ÷ entry price). It's "impermanent" only if price returns. Withdraw after the move and it's permanent. Full LP P&L = LP value + fees + incentives − gas, compared to hold value.

scenes.vo: Here's the picture: Impermanent loss versus holding.

scenes.title: Worked example
scenes.vo: Starting $6,000, +$1,058 (mostly from ETH going up, not from LPing). Holding, +$58, the actual value added by LPing.
scenes.cap: Starting $6,000, +$1,058 (mostly from ETH going up, not from LPing) Holding, +$58, the actual value added by LPing

scenes.vo: Deposit 1 ETH + 3,000 U.S.D.C. at ETH = $3,000 (total $6,000). ETH rises to $4,000. Pool rebalances you to the square root of (3,000 divided by 4,000) = 0.866 ETH and the square root of (3,000 times 4,000) = 3,464 U.S.D.C. L.P. value = 0.866 times 4,000 + 3,464 = $6,928 Hold value = 4,000 + 3,000 = $7,000 to impermanent loss = minus $72 (minus 1.03%) Fees earned $150, gas $20 to L.P. total $7,058 A master judges the L.P. on the +$58, not the +$1,058. Calculator: the calculator
scenes.cap: Deposit 1 ETH + 3,000 USDC at ETH = $3,000 (total $6,000). ETH rises to $4,000. Pool rebalances you to √(3,000 ÷ 4,000) = 0.866 ETH and √(3,000 × 4,000) = 3,464 USDC LP value = 0.866 × 4,000 + 3,464 = $6,928 Hold value = 4,000 + 3,000 = $7,000 → IL = −$72 (−1.03%) Fees earned $150, gas $20 → LP total $7,058 A master judges the LP on the +$58, not the +$1,058.
